Ashok, Deepak and Priya enter into a partnership by investing Rs. 8500, Rs. 7650 and Rs. 10200 respectively for 1 year. If the share of Ashok is Rs. 500 then find 20% of average share of Priya and Deepak.
questions.solution_en:
Ratio of share of Ashok, Deepak and Priya = 8500:7650:10200 = 10:9:12

Share of Ashok = 500 Rs.

Total profit = (31/10) * 500 = 1550 Rs.

Share of Priya = 1550 * 12/31 = 600 Rs.

Share of Deepak = 1550 * (9/31) = 450 Rs.

20% of average share of Priya and Deepak = 20% * (600 + 450)/2 = 105 Rs.

questions.q_en:
If p = Sin A + Cos A and q = Sin A - Cos A, then what is the value of 
p2 - 1
questions.solution_en:
p = SinA + CosA (Given)

p2 = (SinA + CosA)2 = Sin2A + Cos2A + 2SinACosA = 1 + Sin2A

q = SinA - CosA

q2 = (SinA - CosA)2 = Sin2A + Cos2A - 2SinACosA = 1 - Sin2A

Now the value of expression = (p2 - 1)/(1 - q2) = (1 + Sin2A - 1)/(1 - 1 + Sin2A)

=> Sin2A/Sin2A = 1

questions.q_en: What is the cube root of the product of all positive multiples of 8 less than 45?
questions.solution_en:
All positive multiples of 8 less than 45 = 8, 16, 24, 32, 40

Product = 8 * 16 * 24 * 32 * 40 = 86 * 15

Required value = ∛(86 * 15) = 64∛15

questions.q_en: A man looks at the reflection of the top of the lamp-post on the mirror that is 6.6 m away from the foot of the lamppost. The man's height is 1.25 m and he is standing 2 m away from the mirror. Assuming that the mirror is placed on the ground, facing the sky and the man, and that the mirror and the lamp-post are in a same line, find the height of the lamp-post (in metres).
questions.solution_en:
Let the height of the lamppost be x meters.

Using the similarity:

x/6.6=1.25/2

h = 6.6 X 1.25/2

h = 6.6 X 0.625

h = 4.125 meters≈4.13 metres.

Option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: Pipe A fills in 8 h and pipe B empties in 24 h. They operate alternately: A for 3 h, then B for 1 h, and so on. How long from the start will it take to fill the tank completely?
questions.solution_en:
Rate of A = 1/8; Rate of B = −1/24

Work by A in 3 h = 3/8

Work by B in 1 h = −1/24

Net per 4 h cycle = 3/8 − 1/24 = 1/3

Number of cycles = 1/(1/3) = 3 cycles

Total time = 3 X 4 = 12 h

questions.q_en: There are total 40 students in a class in which 60% are boys. Average marks of all students of the class in Hindi are 70. If average marks of all girls in Hindi are 75, then find the average marks of boys in same subject.
questions.solution_en:
Total students = 40

Boys = 60% of 40 = 24

Girls = 40 - 24 = 16

Total marks of all students together = 70 x 40 = 2800

Total marks of girls = 75 x 16 = 1200

Total marks of boys = 2800 - 1200 = 1600

Average marks of boys = 1600/24 = 200/3

questions.q_en: A tangent XY touches a circle at A. Two chords are drawn from A to B and C such that BC = BA. If angle made by chord AB with tangent XY is 75⁰ respectively, and D is a point on minor arc of BC, then find ∠BDC.
questions.solution_en:
XY is the tangent that touches the circle at A.

∠YAB = ∠ACB = 75⁰ (property of circle)

Since, BC = BA;

∠ACB = ∠CAB = 75⁰

Hence, ∠CAB + ∠BDC = 180⁰ (sum of angles on opposite arcs)

∠BDC = 180⁰ - 75⁰ = 105⁰

questions.q_en: At the Mystica Academy of Magic, young sorceress Meera sets out to buy enchanted scrolls for her 8 fellow apprentices. Some need lined scrolls for spell scripting, priced at ₹50 each, while others prefer plain scrolls for rune drawing, which cost ₹60 each. She spends exactly ₹420 on all 8 scrolls at the wizarding bookstore. How many plain scrolls did Meera purchase?
questions.solution_en:
Let number of plain scrolls bought be X then number of lined scrolls be (8 - X).

Given that,

60X + 50(8 - X) = 420

60X + 400 - 50X = 420

X = 2

The number of plain notebooks bought is 2.

questions.q_en: A cuboid shaped container measuring 10 cm, 14 cm, and 6 cm needs to be constructed from aluminum sheet. What will be the total surface area of the container?
questions.solution_en:
Length, breadth, and height of the container are 10 cm, 14 cm, and 6 cm respectively.

Total surface area of the container = 2 (lb + bh + hl) = 2 * (10 * 14 + 14 * 6 + 10 * 6) = 2 * (140 + 84 + 60)

= 2 * 284

= 568 cm2

questions.q_en: A can do a piece of work in 30 days, B in 50 days and C in 40 days. If A is assisted by B on one day and by C on the next day alternately, the work will be completed in:
questions.solution_en:
Total work = LCM of 30, 50, and 40 = 600

A's one day work = 600/30 = 20

B's one day work = 600/50 = 12

C's one day work = 600/40 = 15

Total one day work when A and B together works = 20 + 12 = 32

Total one day work when A and C together works = 20 + 15 = 35

Total 2 days work = 32 + 35 = 67

Total work in 16 days = (67/2) * 16 = 536

Total work in 17 days = 536 + 32 = 568

Remaining work = 600 - 568 = 32

Hence, total time taken to finish the work = 17 + (32/35) = 17(32/35) days

questions.q_en: Find the least number, which is exactly divisible by 36, 42, 54, 72 and 80.
questions.solution_en:
Required number = LCM of 36, 42, 54, 72 and 80

Factors of 36 = 2 * 2 * 3 * 3 = 22 * 32

Factors of 42 = 2 * 3 * 7

Factors of 54 = 2 * 3 * 3 * 3 = 2 * 33

Factors of 72 = 2 * 2 * 2 * 3 * 3 = 23 * 32

Factors of 80 = 2 * 2 * 2 * 2 * 5 = 24 * 5

LCM = 24 * 33 * 5 * 7 = 15120

questions.q_en: A and B together can complete a certain work in 20 days whereas B and C together can complete it in 24 days. If A is twice as good a work man as C, then in what time will B alone do 40% of the same work?
questions.solution_en:
A = 2C

LCM of 20 and 24 = 120

Efficiency of A and B = 120/20 = 6

Efficiency of B and C = 120/24 = 5

2C + B = 6 ------(1)

B + C = 5 -------(2)

Subtracting eq(2) from eq(1) -

C = 1, B = 4

Time taken by B to complete 40% of total work = 120* (40/100) * (1/4) = 12 days

questions.q_en:
Simplify the following:

(2x - 3y)(4x2 + 6xy + 9y2) - 7x3 + 26y3
questions.solution_en:
We know, a3 - b3 = (a - b)(a2 + ab + b2)

Here, (2x - 3y)(4x2 + 6xy + 9y2) - 7x3 + 26y3

= (2x - 3y)((2x)2 + (2x)(3y) + (3y)2) - 7x3 + 26y3

= ((2x)3 - (3y)3) - 7x3 + 26y3

= 8x3 - 27y3 - 7x3 + 26y3

= x3 - y3

questions.q_en: Two runners, Sony and Mony, start running on a circular track of length 200 m at speeds of 18 and 24 km/h, respectively, in the same direction. After how much time from the start will they meet again at the starting point?
questions.solution_en:
Speed of Sony = 18 km/h = 5 m/s

Speed of Mony = 24 km/h = 20/3 m/s

Time taken by Sony to cover one round of the track = 200/5 = 40 sec

Time taken by Mony to cover one round of the track = 200/(20/3) = 30 sec

LCM of 40 sec and 30 sec = 120 sec

Hence, Sony and Mony will meet again at the starting point after travelling for 120 sec.

questions.q_en: If Amit's salary is 60% more than Ajay's salary, then Ajay's salary is what percent less than the salary of Amit?
questions.solution_en:
Let Amit's salary be S and Ajay's salary be T

S = 1.6T

T = (1/1.6) x S = 0.625 S = 62.5% of S

Ajay's salary is 37.5% less than the salary of Amit.

A certain sum is invested for certain time at simple interest. It amounts to Rs 200 at 12% per annum. But when invested at 4% per annum, it amounts to Rs 100. Find the time?
questions.solution_en:
A certain sum is invested for certain time. It amounts to Rs X at P% per annum. But when invested at Q% per annum, it amounts to Rs Y.

Then the time = [(X-Y)/(YP-XQ)]*100

Here X = Rs 200, Y = Rs 100, P = 12%, Q = 4%

So time = [(200-100)/(100*12-200*4)]*100

Time = (100/400)*100 = 25 years

questions.q_en:
Find the values of x, y and z, so as to satisfy the equations given below:

x + y + z = 12; x + y - z = 6; x - y + z = 4
questions.solution_en:
Adding (x + y + z = 12) and (x + y - z=6):

2x +2y = 18

So from this we get

x + y= 9----(i)

On subtracting (x - y + z = 4) from ( x + y+ z =12):

2y=8

y=4.

Now putting value of y in equation (i) ,

X=9 - 4= 5

Here x + y + z=12

So z=12 - 4 - 5= 3

So values are as follows:-

x = 5, y = 4 and z =3

option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: The base of a right prism is an equilateral triangle. If the lateral surface area of prism and the volume of the prism is 1440 cm2 and 2880√3 cm3 respectively, then find the side of the base of the prism.
questions.solution_en:
Let the base of prism and height of the prism be 'a' cm and h cm respectively.

Lateral surface area of the prism = Perimeter of base * height

3 * a * h = 1440

ah = 480

The volume of the prism = Area of base * height

√3/4 * a2 * h = 2880√3

a * 480 = 2880 * 4

a = 24 cm
